name: Should a plastic surgeon hire an agency for AEO, or can they do it themselves?

mainEntity.name: Should a plastic surgeon hire an agency for AEO, or can they do it themselves?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a plastic surgeon or their internal team can manage basic AEO tasks, hiring an experienced digital marketing agency often yields better and faster results. A specialized agency possesses expertise in advanced keyword research for answer queries, content structuring for featured snippets, technical SEO implementation, and continuous monitoring of search algorithm changes. They can dedicate resources to detailed content creation and optimization, which can be time-consuming for a busy practice. An agency can also provide comprehensive reporting and strategic adjustments to maximize your practice's visibility and patient engagement.
acceptedAnswer.description: While some AEO can be done internally, hiring an experienced agency provides specialized expertise, faster results, and dedicated resources for optimal performance.
